summary: Mebanazine was pulled from the market in the United Kingdom starting in 1975 because of liver harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated low risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. Similar drugs have also been removed from markets due to liver harm, heart harm, or neurotoxicity, which means damage to the nervous system [3][4].
